title: Supplementary material (interactive figures) for the PhD thesis "Efficient High Speed Modulation Techniques for a Sensing Application"
description:
Interactive versions of figures from a PhD thesis on multiplexed time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (MP-ToF-SIMS) at The University of Manchester, with the reduced data each one draws. The thesis PDF is the examined record and carries a static version of every figure. Each page states whether its data are measured or illustrative (simulated), and records the source file, its SHA-256 and the code that reduced it.

The site is self-contained: open index.html through any web server. Third-party components (Plotly 2.35.2, MIT; IBM Plex fonts, SIL OFL 1.1) are bundled with their licences in vendor/.
